object_label: environment associated with a plant part or small plant
notes: Cohort review: 'Root-Rhizome' is root OR rhizome; PO:0004542 'rhizome' silently drops the root, which is the commoner isolation site of the two. Kept as a narrower kind of the plant-part environment rather than grounded to half of itself.

Cohort review: NCIT:C14258 'Plant' is the organism, not decomposing plant material — a plainly wrong target that passed the label check because its id and label agree. ENVO:01000628 'plant litter' is the near miss but is narrower (litter is decomposing plant matter on the ground) and is already claimed by the 'Plant-litter-Forest' source and the environment table. Genuinely a habitat, genuinely no term.

Cohort review: NCIT:C17649 'Other' is a bucket with no meaning of its own, and it absorbs 'Rodentia-Other' too — one record labelled 'Other' holding rodents and invertebrates. The invertebrate-associated environment terms in the slice are all aquatic-qualified. Real habitat, no term.
Cohort review: the other half of the NCIT:C17649 'Other' merge. Same reasoning as the invertebrate source it was collapsing with — a bucket term is not an identity.
Cohort review: a host taxon is not a habitat, the same call as every other animal source here. The mapping also drops the sheep half of 'Sheep/Goat'. Link kept as an xref.

Cohort review: NCIT:C43963 'Creek' drops the river half. ENVO:00000029 'watercourse' is the genus of both river and creek, so it covers the source instead of picking one branch of it. Merges with the existing GOLD watercourse record, which is the harmonization working.

Cohort review: flagged by the screen as a dropped modifier, but correct. BacDive's 'Plant-Factory' sits under Engineered/Industrial, where 'plant' means facility rather than vegetation, so ENVO:01000536 'factory' is the right term and the dropped word is a duplicate of it.

object_label: environment associated with a plant part or small plant
notes: Cohort review: NCIT:C45313 'Part' is a bucket term carrying none of the meaning. A surface-sterilized plant part is the endophyte isolation route and is a narrower kind of plant-part environment.
Cohort review: Anthozoa is the coral class, a host taxon rather than a habitat. ENVO:00000150 'coral reef' is a habitat but names the reef, not the animal the strain came from. Link kept as an xref.
Cohort review: no words shared with the target, but UBERON:0001005 'respiratory airway' is the correct term for 'Airways'. This source, not the oral-cavity composite, is the one entitled to it.
Cohort review: a host taxon is not a habitat, and the mapping also drops the 'aquatic' qualifier that is the only thing distinguishing this source from the generic mammal one. Link kept as an xref.
Cohort review: FOODON:00003004 'animal' is the organism, not its decomposing remains. ENVO:00002033 'carcass' is what a decomposing animal is as a habitat; merges with the existing carcass record.

Cohort review: NCIT:C85060 'Natural' is a bucket term that this source shares with 'Juice-natural' — two unrelated foods on one record. Naturally-produced animal food is a narrower kind of animal food product; kept as a parent so the natural/processed distinction survives.

Cohort review: the other half of the NCIT:C85060 'Natural' merge. BTO:0000659 'juice' already carries GOLD's generic Juice path, so grounding here would drop the natural/processed distinction this source exists to make.
Cohort review: NCIT:C33446 'Root' is unqualified and reads as a plant root, not the root of a tooth. The slice has no tooth-root term. Real habitat, no term.

Cohort review: NCIT:C48957 'Tower' is a structure of any kind. The slice has cooling processes and ENVO:03600002 'cooling water' but no cooling tower; the water is the medium, not the site. A Legionella habitat worth an ENVO term request.
Cohort review: humidity is a property of a habitat, not a habitat — the same call already made for 'Acidic' against PATO:0001429. Link kept as an xref.
Cohort review: dust and ash are different materials and the slice has both (ENVO:00002008, ENVO:02000090). Grounding to either half would assert an identity the source does not have.
